target_definition_assessment.candidate_target: 10m hourly measured wind speed (v_wind in m/s) at Abisko Aut
target_definition_assessment.explanation: Abisko 10m wind speed is scientifically defensible as an empirical proxy target representing the regional Nuolja/Abisko polar microgrid context, but site-transfer limitations (310m altitude offset, valley floor vs mountain ridge topography) remain unresolved and must be carried into future research governance.

topographic_comparison.abisko_aut_terrain: Low-gradient valley floor / Lake Torneträsk shoreline (341m lake level)
topographic_comparison.nuolja_aws_terrain: Eastern mountain ridge slope of Mount Nuolja (702m)
topographic_comparison.physical_implications: Mountain slope experiences ridge speed-up and katabatic slope flows; valley floor experiences lake-breeze and surface roughness friction. Wind speeds are correlated but not physically identical.

altitude_issue.finding: No authorized altitude transfer model exists in repository governance. Raw data was NOT rescaled, and generic wind-profile equations were NOT applied in A1.6.

measurement_height_issue.finding: Dataset represents 10m height 1-hour average wind speed. No height conversion formula was applied, and 10m wind is NOT claimed to be turbine-hub wind.

wind_speed_vs_wind_power_distinction.finding: Target is measured wind speed (m/s). No turbine power curve was introduced, no conversion to Watts was performed, and measured wind generation capability is NOT claimed.

temporal_task_qualification.finding: 8,784 continuous hourly records for 2024 provide structural compatibility for future 24-hour receding-horizon forecasting formulations.

a2_readiness_assessment.statement: A2 requires resolution of the documented data limitations before authorization.
unresolved_prerequisites: Formal project governance decision authorizing either (a) using Abisko 10m measured wind speed directly as the microgrid base station target, or (b) authorizing an explicit altitude/boundary layer transfer model.
Formal project governance authorization of an explicit IEC 61400-12-1 wind turbine power curve model (P = f(v)) to map wind speed (m/s) to electrical power (W) for ForecastBundle.wind_generation.
Pre-registration of canonical train/val/test temporal fold splits matching Stage8.1.
Pre-registration of baseline benchmark models (Naive Persistence, Raw NWP) and evaluation metrics (MAE, RMSE).
Separate explicit project governance authorization granting Phase A2.

limitation_statements: Geographic proximity (~4.1 km) does not establish identical wind conditions.
Measured wind speed (m/s) does not establish measured wind generation (W).
No altitude correction formula was invented or applied in A1.6.
No turbine power curve was introduced in A1.6.
No empirical wind-model performance is claimed.
No wind forecasting capability has yet been demonstrated or trained.
